subject: [PATCH 34/60] mm/mempolicy: don't rebind policies onto private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new function mpol_rebindable_mems() that rebinds policies over non-private nodes and records the remap base accordingly. This addresses issues related to policy rebinding in the mm/mempolicy module.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues related to policy rebinding in the mm/mempolicy module. Specifically, it prevents policies from being rebound onto private nodes, which can cause unexpected behavior. The patch introduces a new function mpol_rebindable_mems() that rebinds policies over non-private nodes and records the remap base accordingly.
